title: Opening Rules of the Twin-Bolt Thrower
summary: Opens the school's paired thunder to a Warrior, with duet sparks, matched falls and the founding twin cast.

title: Hawk-Cry Manual of the Basin Thunderer
summary: Teaches thunder timed to a hawk-like cry that startles the foe, ending in the school's screaming peal.

title: Treatise of the Azure Arc Master
summary: Trains the master's arc, drawn bright against the sky, from the first draw to the school's final judgement.

title: Book of the Hollow Thunder
summary: Shows a Xiantian student how to shape the field into a resonant hollow that amplifies each peal and bolt.

title: Treatise of the Core Thunder and the Twin Horizons
summary: Draws thunder from the formed core to two horizons at once, ending in the school's core-born peal.

title: First Oath-Book of the Plateau Thunderer
summary: Gives a Warrior the first oath of the plateau thunderer, with sworn lines, edge bolts and a sworn roar.

title: Wind-Sworn Thunder Manual
summary: Teaches thunder sworn to the wind and leaned into its course, ending in a vowed peal.

title: Treatise on the Bearing Held Against Thunder
summary: Trains the thunderer to hold a bearing through crashing peals, from the braced stance to the unbent roar.

title: Canon of the Open Roar
summary: A Xiantian canon of thunder that takes no wall and no shelter, the whole body open to the roar.

title: Book of the Oathcore and the Gale Thunder
summary: Gives a Core student the plateau's oath and the formed core together, ending in the school's storming peal.
